name: soft-key-door-goal
task: Pick up the key, then open the door, and then, ideally, walk onto the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause Existence(has_key) is redundant because door_open must occur (hard Existence) and cannot happen before has_key (hard Precedence). Removing this clause does not change the set of accepted runs. Drop the Existence(has_key) clause and keep the other four clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause R1 `Existence(has_key)` is redundant because the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) together with hard Existence(door_open) already forces that has_key occurs before door_open. Removing R1 does not alter the set of accepted runs but eliminates an unnecessary requirement. Delete R1 and keep the remaining clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(has_key) clause is redundant because the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) together with Existence(door_open) already forces a has_key event. Remove that clause; keep the remaining clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(has_key) clause is redundant, as the other hard clauses already imply that the key must be acquired (door_open requires has_key, and door_open must occur). Remove the hard Existence(has_key) clause and keep the remaining hard and soft clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(has_key) clause is redundant, because Existence(door_open) together with Precedence(has_key, door_open) already guarantees that has_key will occur. Remove that clause and keep the other hard Existence(door_open), Precedence(has_key, door_open) and the soft Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the goal after opening the door. The compiled machine finishes as soon as the door is opened, because it has a hard Existence(door_open) clause and final state u3 is reached when door_open occurs, with no requirement that at_goal becomes true. Add a hard Existence(at_goal) clause (or otherwise require at_goal in the final state) so that the task cannot be considered complete until the agent walks onto the goal. This will align the clauses with the task’s completion definition.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent eventually picks up the key" is redundant. Since we already have a hard Existence(door_open) and a hard Precedence(has_key, door_open), any run that satisfies the machine must visit has_key before opening the door. Remove the hard Existence(has_key) clause and keep the other four clauses.

texts: The agent eventually opens the door.
The door cannot be opened before the key is acquired.
The goal cannot be reached before the door is opened.
Ideally, the agent eventually walks onto the goal.
